## 🧾 Summary

Describe the problem, affected pages, and expected result.

## 🔍 Scope

- [ ] Home page
- [ ] About page
- [ ] Media page
- [ ] Shared CSS
- [ ] Images or other assets
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] GitHub automation

Describe the exact behaviour changed and what remains a known limitation.

## 🧪 Validation

- [ ] Opened all affected pages through a local static server.
- [ ] Checked local image, CSS, and JavaScript requests.
- [ ] Reviewed browser console errors.
- [ ] Tested desktop and mobile layouts.
- [ ] Checked keyboard navigation and focus.
- [ ] Reviewed image alt text.
- [ ] Reviewed CDN and external widget behaviour.
- [ ] Checked relative links and filename case.

**Browser, viewport, and validation evidence:**

## 🖼️ Screenshots

Add screenshots captured from the real running pages when the visual output changes. Do not include private data.

## 🔐 Security, privacy, and licensing

- [ ] No secrets or private contact data added.
- [ ] New artwork has documented source and usage permission.
- [ ] External scripts and fonts use appropriate HTTPS sources.
- [ ] Any new third-party widget or resource is documented.

## 📚 Documentation

- [ ] README and relevant guides updated.
- [ ] Changelog or roadmap updated accurately.
- [ ] Diagrams updated if page dependencies changed.

## ⚠️ Risks and rollback

Describe potential visual, browser, accessibility, dependency, or licensing risks and how to revert the change.
